description_en: Modifies the vector search engine optimization configuration of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 修改实例向量引擎优化配置
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb modify-vector-configuration --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --vector-configuration-status enabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVectorConfiguration

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable vector engine optimization. Valid values:

enabled
disabled

We recommend that you do not enable vector engine optimization in mainstream analysis and real-time data warehousing scenarios.
We recommend that you enable vector engine optimization in AI Generated Content (AIGC) and vector retrieval scenarios that require the vector analysis engine
parameters.help_zh:
是开开启向量引擎优化配置。取值如下：

enabled：开启向量引擎优化。
disabled：不开启向量引擎优化。

对于主流分析场景、数仓场景、实时数仓等场景，建议不开启向量引擎优化。
对于使用向量分析引擎用于AIGC、向量检索等场景用户，建议开启向量引擎优化
parameters.name: vector_configuration_status
